articles.image_title: USA: A person shops for eggs on mostly empty shelves as residents stock up on supplies ahead of a cold front expected in the area in Arlington, Virginia, on January 23, 2026. A massive winter storm was set to drop a mix of freezing rain and heavy snow on some 160 million Americans starting January 23, threatening to bring dangerously icy conditions. Multiple US states declared states of emergency as meteorologists said the storm would soon begin marching across much of the continental US, covering a wide swath of the country's middle including the Rockies and Plains.
